item.title: [infoq] RTX 4060 跑 35B 模型，每秒 39 Token？伯克利、MIT 联手开源 FreeToken
item.description: UC Berkeley and MIT researchers have open-sourced FreeToken, an inference engine aimed at running sparse MoE models efficiently on consumer hardware. Instead of stalling the GPU when expert weights miss the cache, it dynamically schedules token computation across CPU and GPU cores based on available PCIe throughput and reuses attention states. The authors report 3-4x faster decoding and 6-30x faster prefill than llama.cpp/Ollama on the same models.

item.description: Uber has introduced GitFarm, a Git-as-a-service platform that centralizes Git operations across its large monorepos. item.title: [infoq] FlexGanttFX 正式开源
item.description: After 15 years of development, Dirk Lemmerman released FlexGanttFX as open source under AGPL—a JavaFX-based resource scheduling framework for Gantt charts that runs on desktop and mobile. It uses a single Canvas to render even complex charts at high performance and treats time zones and weekends as part of its time model. The AGPL license also obligates modified versions to be opened to network users, so SaaS teams should evaluate the implications before adoption.
